Hamilton County Sheriff’s Office

# Crash Report Instructions

Those with their report numbers can access their crash reports [here](https://www.crashdocs.org/#/reports?state=OH&agencyORI=OH0310000).

If you do not have your report number or require further assistance, the Bureau of Records can be contacted at 513-946-6220 Monday through Friday from 7am-3pm.

All commercial (non-involved) parties can access reports [here](https://www.carfaxforclaims.com/).
